card.name: Opioid warning phrases before risk groups
card.fires_on: Small words like "patients", "is", "are" or "when" in opioid label warnings, just before a risk condition such as a history of substance abuse or use with other drugs.

modes.label: Risks increased in patients
modes.description: The word "patients" after "Risks are increased in" in opioid abuse and misuse warnings.
modes.example: Risks are increased in<< patients>> with a personal or family history of substance

modes.label: Used with other drugs
modes.description: The verb "is" or "are" after a drug name, just before "given concomitantly with other drugs".
modes.example: TUXARIN ER<< is>> given concomitantly with other drugs

modes.label: Handling precaution
modes.description: The word "when" in a handling instruction about gloves during preparation.
modes.example: during reconstitution and<< when>> wiping the outer surface of the bottle/c

card.writes: It seems to push away words about safety and protection, which fits a risk-warning continuation.
card.plain: It fires on the linking word in opioid label warnings, right before the text names who is at higher risk or what drugs are combined.
